components.name: Update reports
components.description: Primary submit action inside the analytics main region.
components.css: .ds-button{min-height:42px;padding:0 18px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font:800 12px/1 var(--body,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.035em;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,background 150ms ease}.ds-button:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-button:active{transform:translateY(0)}.ds-button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.72;transform:none}.ds-primary{color:white;background:var(--red,#e33b3f);box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(227,59,63,.18)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--red-dark,#b7202d);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(183,32,45,.22)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-outline,#1859a9);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

components.name: Aggregate table
components.description: Captioned provider report with local horizontal scrolling; illustrative data only.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap{margin:28px 0;overflow-x:auto}.ds-table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font:14px var(--body,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text,#10223a)}.ds-table caption{text-align:left;font-weight:600;padding-bottom:14px}.ds-table th{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted,#647084);background:var(--table-header-tint,rgba(16,34,58,.035))}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dcd9d1);padding:12px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.ds-table th:first-child,.ds-table td:first-child{text-align:left;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:320px}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--row-hover,rgba(24,89,169,.04))}

narrative.overview: This bounded record describes the completed admin surface, not a replacement identity. The page inherits the public application's cream grid, ink text, red action emphasis, condensed headings, and shared header/button primitives. Provider reports use flat sections, definition lists, and tables to keep dense information legible.
keyCharacteristics: Flat report sections and tabular numbers.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the shared theme variables for this surface; do not introduce a separate provider palette.

rules.name: The Definition Beside Value Rule
rules.body: Keep metric definitions and provider notes adjacent to the values they qualify.

rules.name: The Provider Boundary Rule
rules.body: Preserve separate provider sections and their range/state labels at every viewport size.

dos: Do retain shared theme variables, fonts, branding, and button states.
Do preserve source labels, definitions, and tabular numeric alignment.
Do keep horizontal table overflow local and metric grids responsive.
donts: Don't introduce a separate admin visual identity or colored provider cards.
Don't replace metric definitions with decorative icons or unlabeled numbers.
Don't treat the default light palette as a reason to remove inherited dark mode.
